correctness.rationale: For K2,n n>=3, the no-two-hub-flag subcomplex Y is homotopy equivalent to join_i S0=S^(n-1) via one-hub cones on contractible links. Each [x_i,y_j]*L_ij is an attached n-ball; the diagonal attachment maps have degree +/-1 to H_(n-1)(Y) and off-diagonal ones have zero degree, so the integral top kernel is the diagonal augmentation lattice A_n plus free off-diagonal B_n. Hub swap orientation contributes (-1)^n on diagonal and (-1)^(n+1) with reversal on B. Independently enumerated entire Morse faces for n=3 (215 faces) and n=4 (944 faces) and evaluated signed reduced Lefschetz traces for hub swap, leaf transposition and composites; all matched predicted module characters. Finite checks corroborate the general relative-cell proof and do not replace it.
